name: Rune Prison
blurb: Active:  Ryze seizes the target enemy, dealing magic damage and briefly  slowing them.

effects.description: Active: Ryze seizes the target enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing them by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
Flux Bonus: The target is rooted instead of slowed.

notes:
Rune Prison can be buffered 0.5 seconds before it comes off cooldown.
If the target becomes  untargetable,  dies, or is too far away or no longer in  sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
